title: Light Review Result
description: Return of the lens agent in a light review: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, the focus changes it made and its findings, each tagged with a focus

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: An open question that affected the review, or null

reason.description: Why the focus was added or dropped

focus.description: The focus the finding was found through

claim.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences, grounded in evidence the agent read

where.description: A file path with an optional line, or the subject item
